data.name: Jenilee
data.gender_notes: Jenilee is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jenilee is derived from the elements 'Jeni' (Jehovah is gracious) and 'Lee' (the God of my heart). This beautiful name evokes images of a joyful and gentle spirit, one who is deeply connected to her faith and her loved ones. The name Jenilee carries the meaning “Joyful and gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jenilee usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful and gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name given to one who embodies the gentle grace and love of Jehovah.
data.etymology: Jenilee belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful and gentle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jenilee total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Jenilee
in_english.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English 'Gemel' meaning 'dear one' or 'beloved', and 'Lee' meaning 'meadow' or 'clearing'. The name Jenilee can be interpreted as 'beloved meadow' or 'dear one of the clearing'. It evokes images of a joyful, gentle, fair, and gracious person.

data.cultural_impact: Jenilee carries the softness and warmth of Jeni, a name rooted in the Hebrew language deriving from Jehovah, the God of the Bible - emphasising a deep connection to the Judeo-Christian tradition. The name Lea, which shares etymological roots with Lee, has a Scottish origin and has a tradition rich with independence, determination, and grace - values venerated across Christian culture. Together, Jenilee encapsulates a unique blend of tender grace and resilient strength.
data.spiritual_significance: Jenilee embodies the deep love and connection to God that transcends beyond temporal concerns. The intimacy conveyed through the name 'Lee' (God of my heart) expresses the innate desire for a close relationship with the Divine, which is at the core of the Christian faith. Jenilee's name underscores a selfless and loving spirit that reflects the grace of God and encourages others to seek the same divine connection within their own lives.
